what: Dropping `|| true` without an rc-tolerant wrapper conflicts with `set -euo pipefail`
scenario_or_breakage: `review-and-fix commit-fixes --stage-all` returns non-zero on a clean tree (`git commit` with nothing staged after `git add -A`); the script exits before parsing `COMMITTED=` / porcelain and never reaches `review-and-fix step5`, so MAV/coder resume breaks on the common no-op handoff
suggested_fix: In `step-5-resume.sh`, capture commit-fixes rc without aborting (subshell or `set +e` block), relay KV stdout, then branch: exit non-zero only when porcelain is non-empty after `COMMITTED=false`; otherwise continue to `step5`. Optionally add a matching clean-tree no-op in `commit_fixes` (exit 0, `COMMITTED=false`) and pin it in tests
